Frequently asked questions

Is Mercati generali safe?

Wandroz currently rates Mercati generali in Turin as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Turin publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Mercati generali safe at night?

At night, Mercati generali is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Mercati generali a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Mercati generali's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
